sentences.en: Don't be so greedy or you'll wind up with nothing.
sentences.zh: 别这么贪婪，否则你会一无所有的。

sentences.en: He does not need to eat, he is just greedy.
sentences.zh: 他不需要吃东西，这只是因为他很贪心。

sentences.en: We can't let these greedy bastards take what is ours.
sentences.zh: 我们不能让这些贪婪的家伙拿走属于我们的东西。

senses.zh: 贪婪的，贪心的；贪吃的，嘴馋的；渴望的
